nodes.description: Privileged admin address set in constructor to msg.sender; exempt from burn fee and buy limit and sole caller able to withdraw contract ETH.
Burn fee percentage (2) applied on every transfer that is not involving the admin.
Boolean latch indicating whether the first transfer has occurred; used to record the launch block.
Block number of the first transfer; anchors the 20-block anti-bot buy limit window.
Mapping of account balances updated in _transfer and addBalance.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances updated by _approve.
Total token supply; decreased by amountBurn on transfers and increased on minting via addBalance.
Token name string set in ERC20Detailed constructor.
Token symbol string set in ERC20Detailed constructor.
Token decimals value set in ERC20Detailed constructor.
ERC20 transfer entry point; calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom; performs _transfer and then decrements spender allowance via _approve.
ERC20 approve; sets allowance from _msgSender() to spender via _approve.
Increases the caller's allowance for a spender using SafeMath.add.
Decreases the caller's allowance for a spender using SafeMath.sub.
Core internal transfer logic: applies the 20-block anti-bot buy limit, the 2% burn, updates balances, mints nothing, and records firstBlock on the first transfer.
Internal minting helper that credits a balance and increases _totalSupply.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
Admin-only function that sends the whole contract ETH balance to msg.sender.
View helper returning block.number - firstBlock, i.e. blocks elapsed since launch.
Returns the balance of an account.
Returns the current total supply.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for owner.
Internal Context helper returning msg.sender.
dKore constructor: sets admin to msg.sender and mints 5000e18 tokens to the admin for the liquidity pool.
Payable fallback function accepting ETH into the contract.
Returns the token name.
Returns the token symbol.
Returns the token decimals.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for admin assignment, minting, approvals and the ETH withdrawal recipient.
External ETH transfer msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) inside withdraw; recipient and amount are caller/state dependent.
Unchecked arithmetic block.number < firstBlock + 20 used for the anti-bot window; raw uint addition instead of SafeMath.
sender parameter of _transfer, the account debited.
recipient parameter of _transfer, the account credited.
amount parameter of _transfer, the transferred quantity subject to the anti-bot cap.
amountRec local variable in _transfer holding the post-burn amount credited to the recipient.
amountLimit local variable in _transfer (151e18) enforcing the anti-bot buy cap.
amountBurn local variable in _transfer holding the 2% burn amount deducted from _totalSupply.
spender parameter of approve, the address receiving the allowance.
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.
account parameter of addBalance, the mint recipient.
amount parameter of addBalance, the minted quantity.
owner parameter of _approve, the allowance owner.
spender parameter of _approve, the allowance spender.
recipient parameter of the public transfer function.
amount parameter of the public transfer function.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, granting the caller a privileged role (mint, burn exemption, withdraw).
withdraw gates execution on require(msg.sender == admin).
withdraw executes the external ETH transfer to msg.sender only after the admin check.
The ETH transfer recipient is msg.sender, so the caller controls the destination of the whole contract balance.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transfer passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender argument of _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve calls _approve to store the new allowance.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the increased value.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decreased value.
_transfer reaches the anti-bot branch condition block.number < firstBlock + 20, an unchecked uint addition.
firstBlock state variable feeds the unchecked addition firstBlock + 20 in the anti-bot window check.
Inside the 20-block window the require(amount < amountLimit) constrains the transfer amount parameter.
_transfer reads burnFee to compute amountBurn = amount.mul(burnFee).div(100).
_transfer debits _balances[sender] and credits _balances[recipient].
_transfer subtracts amountBurn from _totalSupply, a supply-mutating arithmetic path.
_transfer sets firstTransfer to true after the first successful transfer.
_transfer writes firstBlock = block.number on the first transfer, fixing the anti-bot window.
admin is read in _transfer to bypass the burn and the anti-bot limit for privileged addresses.
The constructor calls addBalance to mint the initial liquidity allocation.
The constructor mints 5000e18 tokens to admin, which was set from msg.sender.
addBalance credits _balances[account].
addBalance increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to all callers of the internal helper.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
sender parameter is consumed by _transfer for the debit and the admin comparison.
recipient parameter is consumed by _transfer for the credit.
amount parameter drives the burn computation and the anti-bot size check in _transfer.
amountRec local is derived from amount minus the burn and credited to the recipient.
amountLimit local defines the buy cap enforced by the anti-bot check in the first 20 blocks.
amountBurn local is subtracted from _totalSupply and emitted as a burn transfer.
spender parameter is forwarded to _approve by approve.
addedValue parameter is added to the existing allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the existing allowance in decreaseAllowance.
account parameter is the mint recipient in addBalance.
amount parameter is added to _balances and _totalSupply in addBalance.
owner parameter keys the _allowances mapping in _approve.
spender parameter keys the _allowances mapping in _approve.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
getFirstBlockTime reads firstBlock to compute the elapsed block count.
